scope: Unmatched: Battle of Legends, Volume One (2019); English IELLO licensed rulebook plus original Alice, King Arthur, Medusa, Sinbad character/action components. Standard duel only; excludes team play, other sets and Adventures.
novelty_criterion: New rule, rule-defined branch or timing/priority/exception interaction. No changed-number hypotheticals, cosmetic wording, or mechanical recombinations without consequence. Card-specific distinct user/type/timing rules are retained; shared same effect copies receive no separate credit.

passes.focus: All core procedures and remaining original action-card effects
Full component audit, intentional absent BOOST and cancellation/discard timing interactions

rationale.Q59: Six non-Home cards cannot pay BOOST; Home exception
rationale.Q60: Feint cancels card effect but not character size ability
rationale.Q61: Discard before moving changes current Voyage count; ignored effect on BOOST payment

passes.focus: Targeted setup/turn/actions/exhaustion/damage/end boundary reread after all source passages mapped
Targeted all four hero abilities and every unique action-card rule, timing/cancellation/destination exceptions

rejections.candidate: Starting hand of different five named cards
rejections.reason: Same setup branch Q01; cosmetic card identities.

rejections.candidate: Have 10 or 11 cards at turn end instead of 9

rejections.reason: Same per-missing-card exhaustion branch Q05; changed count only.

rejections.candidate: Ordinary movement through another arrangement of friendly/enemy tokens
rejections.reason: Same blockers/endpoint/order rules Q03 and owner-relative movement Q36.

rejections.candidate: Attack5 versus defense2 instead of attack4 versus defense4
rejections.reason: Subtraction and positive/zero attack-damage branches already Q09/Q38; changed values do not add rule.

rejections.candidate: Another BIG/SMALL card with the same size switch
rejections.reason: All distinct base size effects asked Q16/Q25; damage timing Q58 and cancellation Q60 covered.

rejections.candidate: Another number of discarded Voyages or other Voyage name
rejections.reason: Same scaled value/movement branch Q15; Home timing and destinations Q20/Q61; changed count/name only.

rejections.candidate: All Harpies defeated instead of one before Winged Frenzy
rejections.reason: Same return-one if-any branch Q19; no new exception.

rejections.candidate: More Restless Spirits defeats or different target spaces
rejections.reason: Zero/one/multiple defeat trigger and both area spaces already Q35; changing names/counts adds no rule.

rejections.candidate: Arthur faces a different cancellation card
rejections.reason: No distinct original card cancellation effect beyond Feint; Q13/Q28/Q57 cover existing timing.

rejections.candidate: Other-set fighters, later special maps, simultaneous unfamiliar damage ties, incomplete Prophecy deck handling
rejections.reason: Different scope or no explicit supported new original-source ruling; no invented questions/answers.
